verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms a CLI (`llama cli`/`llama serve`) that loads models directly (e.g., `-hf ggml-org/...`) and supports GPU/CPU hybrid offload (gh-10, comm-9, comm-11 reference N_GPU_LAYERS and CPU/GPU splitting), showing GPU offload is configurable from the command line.
